scripts.package:vsix: npm run sync-release-metadata && npm run sanitize:release-state && npm run compile && node ./scripts/package-release.mjs
scripts.upgrade:host: npm run package:vsix && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$vsix = Resolve-Path './agent-lee-leeway-coding-system-'+(node -p "require('./package.json').version")+'.vsix'; & "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Microsoft VS Code\bin\code.cmd" --install-extension $vsix --force; Write-Host 'Installed latest local VSIX. Run: Developer: Reload Window'"
